dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'C' and 'O' shaped structures are visible along the dorsal ridge and lateral flank. These features consist of high-intensity white perimeters with irregular, jagged exterior edges and a high-contrast transition to dark charcoal internal cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, high-intensity white pixel clusters is concentrated on the lower lateral region and around the neck area. These clusters are predominantly solid and lack an internal color gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli on the upper mid-body form an elongated scalene triangle, with the longest edge oriented roughly parallel to the dorsal curvature.
